scope: Prospective geometry design only. No waveform generation, no map or calibration fitting, no experiment freeze or promotion.
budget_status: Hypothetical engineering intervals, chosen from the existing window before search; the residual gate does not establish these separate bounds. No calibrated coverage or hard error bound is claimed.

search.selection: Sort by descending minimum separation between all six ideal echoes and direct path, then lexicographic xyz; greedy four stops meeting spacing, clearance and rank criteria. No saved fitted maps or audio influence selection.

error_policy: Reflected-pair exclusion requires ideal separation > window + candidate_budget + prediction_budget. Peak-index lower bound is floor(fs*(separation - 2*candidate_budget) - 1), conservatively accounting for two half-sample interpolations. Direct-pair lower bound uses one candidate budget. Own-candidate inclusion for nonzero prediction error is unknown and must be tested from actual data.
unchanged_criteria: All original geometry, full24path RMS/max, timing, comparator gain and null gates remain; no favorable-subset scoring.
